# Software Projects

All software builds.

## MediChain

Blockchain-powered telemedicine access log focused on auditability and identity-aware access control.

## Civic Lens

Transparent grievance redressal with AI triage, duplicate detection, YOLO violation detection and immutable action log. Built with Next.js 15, Genkit AI, Hardhat and Firebase.

## TollChain

Privacy-aware blockchain tolling concept exploring RFID flows and identity verification.

## MediVault

Decentralized health records concept blending secure storage with AI-assisted handling.

## Freducation

Community academic library with PDF/link/MCQ uploads, Gemini auto-metadata, moderation queue and personalized feed. Built with TanStack Start and Supabase.

## Spectra Guard

FSOC coarse-alignment PAT console with Python physics+EKF+PID engine and Next.js console streaming over WebSocket. SIH ISRO build.

## Mimo Studio

AI-assisted schematic studio monorepo in Rust/egui with prompt-to-plan, typed schematic/BOM proposal and KiCad exports.

## POLARIS-ICE

Physics-based lunar south-pole ice detection converting DFSAR CPR + DEM into ice masks, landing-site ranking and A* rover traverse. Bharatiya Antariksh Hackathon PS-08.

## NAFNet-SR

Semiconductor SEM denoising, deblurring and 4x super-resolution with on-the-fly synthetic degradation. 34.3 dB PSNR vs 30.57 bicubic baseline. KLA Hackathon.

## O.A.S.I.S

RF spectrum-scheduling simulator with Dueling Double DQN + LSTM agent for intercepting frequency-agile emitters.

## Gemini Animator

Prompt-to-animation After Effects tool with ScriptUI panel + CEP extension asking Gemini for JSON action plan.

## CutPilot AI

Premiere Pro CEP panel that uploads clips to Gemini and auto-assembles silence/viral/repeat edits.

## Signal Analyzer

PyQt6 IQ/WAV terrestrial signal intelligence tool with modulation classification, demod, FEC decode and AI brief.
